premises.text: Talented professionals are reduced to resume piles and struggle to stand out when job hunting
premises.evidence_span: when we go look for a job, we get reduced to this. Just another resume and a pile of paper

premises.text: Company-sponsored low-stakes competitions (brain teasers, coding) let professionals compete and climb leaderboards
premises.evidence_span: Competitions are sponsored by companies. They are low stakes

premises.text: Skills scoring, certifications, and badges are the heart of differentiation on Guild
premises.evidence_span: Skills is the heart of Guild. This is what truly differentiates us

premises.text: Career profile plus job recommendations, apply feedback, and rank vs applicants help land interviews
premises.evidence_span: it is recommending jobs that I should be applying for, where I have a good chance of getting an interview

premises.text: Employers sponsor competitions and browse ranked participants to invite passive talent directly
premises.evidence_span: Guild also helps employers target and find the best people

premises.text: Free for professionals; monetize by charging employers; no agencies—direct connect only
premises.evidence_span: Guild is free for professionals. We monetize by charging employers

value.text: Tech professionals compete, connect, and advance careers via social gaming meets career advancement
value.evidence_span: Guild is where social gaming meets career advancement for technology professionals

secondary_value.text: Employers find and invite best talent without agencies
secondary_value.evidence_span: Guild also helps employers target and find the best people

causal_links.evidence_span: This is the problem Guild solves
Guild helps professionals advance their careers in ways that haven't been done before
a place for professionals and employers to connect directly

notes: Leaderboard/achievements/LinkedIn import folded into compete+profile cascade. Job apply feedback/rank folded with recommendations as one job-advance capability. 60k beta users excluded as traction (§4.2). Employer portal kept with monetization as two-sided commercial module. Anti-template: problem, pro product, employer monetization separately revisable.
